The map has ended ($FF byte). Level 4 (number 3) loops its sea map; level 5 (number 4) picks road sections ($09E9); level 3 (number 2) chains map sections from the list at $B835 ($0997); levels 1 and 2 stop scrolling (stop_scrolling).

The main loop shared by the flying levels.
